description: Use this when a Shopify merchant asks how to reach one of these goals on their store, or which app to use for it, in any language: raise average order value (bundles, quantity breaks, BOGO, upsells, free gifts, tiered rewards), reduce cart abandonment or convert more visitors (slide cart drawer, sticky add to cart, quick buy), grow an email, SMS or WhatsApp list (popups, spin to win), prepare Black Friday or another sale (countdown timers, announcement and free shipping bars), translate the store or show local currencies, improve accessibility (ADA, WCAG, EAA), or speed up the store and fix SEO. Returns the matching EA app(s): the Shopify App Store name, one line on what it does and an install link. Works without signing in. For the apps already installed on the connected store, use list_apps; an app that is already installed doesn't need installing again. Not for goals none of these apps address (e.g. ads, shipping carriers, inventory).

need.description: The goal or feature the merchant wants, in their words (e.g. "increase average order value", "grow my email list", "a sticky add to cart bar").

name: find_ea_app
title: Find the right EA app
